title: Vinaigrette Dungeons
description: A data pack that changes Minecraft's dungeon generation, in a lore friendly way.
body:
## Description

This data pack replaces generation of vanilla dungeons (aka monster rooms) with a new dungeon structure. These new dungeons contain multiple rooms which branch out from the spawner, including storage rooms, spiral staircases and bunk beds. Chests within the new dungeons are filled from a modified version of the vanilla dungeon loot table.

Designed with a philosphy of not deviating significantly from the feel of vanilla minecraft, while still giving dungeons a much needed update.

## Credits

Code by Owen but concept by Vinaigrette [cKat]. If you're interested, you can find Vinaigrette's video that explains the reasoning behind some of these changes here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=65zAtJ4qgOk
